Chiricaspy experience:
Brunfelsia grandiflora plants are abundant in my city. I live in Colombia and had read about some of its effects. So I started eating the seeds and they had a somewhat bitter, milky taste. I don't know, but I liked the taste a bit and could eat several capsules. I normally collect the fresh seed pods because they are more active, but mature, dried seeds are more bitter and also have greater narcotic effects.
After about 40 minutes, I start to feel numb and dissociated. The effect is so strange that it begins to affect my hands and body. Little by little, the effects spread to other areas of the body until they reach the brain and the back of my brain.
This plant is usually accompanied by a feeling of freshness. I begin to experience tingling throughout my body and also small spasms. There are no apparent visual effects, but I can perceive things as more metallic.  Mydriasis, I usually eat fruits 2 at a time until I feel satisfied and increase the dose. To do this, I fast for a few hours beforehand, then it makes me very sleepy and suppresses hunger. The nights I consume Chiricaspi I usually sleep quite well and the next day I have a slight headache and some almond flavor in my dry mouth...
